state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk, and every `Novis\Intl` feature owes nothing: the nine classes and the 14 enums.

The five `Novis\Image\Codec` exports `compare`, `hash`, `placeholder`, `palette` and `qr`, `Novis\Image\Diff::constructor` and the enum `Novis\Image\Output` now owe nothing. The exports and `new Diff` are excused from examples, hostile and perf by skip entries in `data/proofs/policy.json`, each naming the member that calls them. Their Rust tests are `covers:` lines in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs` and the new tests in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/image_analysis.rs`.

Still red: `bun nv proofs --gate`, now 2 of 1280 features: `Novis\Image\Image::mime` and `Novis\Image\Image::extension`. Their tests are done (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/image_analysis.rs::mime_and_extension_name_every_format`, and conformance cases already call them). They owe an about page, three examples, one attack and one bench each. Both are pure Novis `match` functions over `Format` that call no export, so no skip entry fits them.

items.text: **Write the about page, three examples, an attack and a bench for `Image::mime`** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), at the paths `bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Image\Image::mime'` prints. The member is `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:92`. It maps the eight `Format` cases, for example `Format::Svg` to `image/svg+xml` and `Format::Pdf` to `application/pdf`. Bless each example with `bun nv proofs --bless`, and record the bench's figure so perf does not read `never measured`.

**The same for `Image::extension`** (`extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:107`): `Format::Jpeg` gives `jpg`, and the others give their lower-case name. Then run `bun nv proofs --gate`, which should print `nothing owed in the whole roster`, and `bun nv proofs --comments docs/examples/novis tests/hostile/novis benches/members/novis`.

backlog: Once the gate is green, run each `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Novis\Intl\…'` check in `data/goals/ext-intl.json` stage 8, then the goal's closing gates (`bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes ext-intl`) before writing `DONE`.
